name: table-size
what: the size of one small program for 32-bit ARM, in bytes: .text, .rodata and their sum, at four states of the headers and in four forms
purpose_in_the_task_list: Owner, 2026-11-14: the five tables of 256 words of the xml, json, js, css and troff writers (738ff29) stay; the size of a program for a small ARM Cortex with the tables and without is measured (-Os, .text and .rodata). This file keeps that measurement, which a session made outside the tree before
method: one build of each state and form, no repetition; the size of each section is read with arm-linux-gnueabihf-size -A from the linked program; a size has no noise, so no round, median or spread is given

states.4dac08e: before the tables (before commit 5 of plan A4)
states.738ff29: commit 5: the five scalar writers store words from the five tables
states.7c3f670: commit 6: the html escape over a proven span
states.d08686b: indent_at returns size_t; the headers need no change for 32 bits

forms.runtime: compile(source, media type read through a volatile pointer, "application/json")

program: bench/probes/table-size/probe.cpp: compiles one template of three tags, renders it over a std::map<std::string, std::string> and writes the answer with std::puts
builds: arm-linux-gnueabihf-g++-16 -std=c++23 -Os -mthumb -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wall -Wextra -Werror, linked with -Wl,--gc-sections against the shared libstdc++, libgcc_s and libc; target armv7-a+fp, hard float (the defaults of the compiler)
headers: include/ of each state, exported with git archive. In the exported copies of 4dac08e, 738ff29 and 7c3f670 the script changes one line of compile.hpp: the lambda indent_at gets the return type size_t, as d08686b has it. arm-linux-gnueabihf compiles these states without the change too (uint32_t and size_t are both unsigned int there); the change is made so that each state builds the same way
time_in_file_name: time stamp of run.sh before the container starts

context.compiler: arm-linux-gnueabihf-g++-16 (Debian 16.2.0-3) 16.2.0; read off a binary: GCC: (Debian 16.2.0-3) 16.2.0
context.kernel_and_machine: Linux 6.18.44-fc-v470 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC @0; machine: Hypervisor vendor: KVM; container: podman, cpus visible 4

not_recorded: the size of the shared libraries that the program loads
a static link, a bare-metal link (arm-none-eabi) and a Cortex-M target
recorded_by: bench/record.py from out/sizes.txt of the work directory, on 2026-11-14; the raw files are not kept
notes: The numbers agree to the byte with the run of the session that made this measurement outside the tree on 2026-11-14.
d08686b gives the same sizes as 7c3f670 in every form.

measurements.name: program size
measurements.values_are: one value: the size of one section, or of .text plus .rodata, of one linked program; one build
